# Constraints for reuse 6.2.0 in licence-check.yml: the packages it depends on,
# with charset-normalizer, which its extra of that name adds, at the versions
# that resolve for CPython 3.12 on x86-64 Linux as PyPI stood when the licence
# check last passed, on 3 October 2026. That run installed all of them but
# charset-normalizer, which it did not ask for. reuse itself comes from its
# source archive, checked against REUSE_SHA256 in licence-check.yml. uv checks
# no hashes when it installs a tool, so these are held by version. Move them
# in the commit that moves reuse: resolve `reuse[charset-normalizer]==X` with
# `uv pip compile` for that Python and platform, and copy its pins here.
attrs==26.1.0
boolean-py==5.0
charset-normalizer==3.5.2
click==8.5.0
jinja2==3.1.6
license-expression==30.4.4
markupsafe==3.0.4
